description: SessionStart points the session at the cas operating manual (MANUAL.md at the plugin root) at session start, resume, clear, and compaction — a plugin-root CLAUDE.md is not loaded on its own, and the manual is too large to inject (Claude Code keeps only the first ~2 KB of hook output), so the hook tells the model to Read it. The review guard (review-guard.sh) snapshots the tree when a cas reviewer is dispatched, records its GATE verdict when it stops, and blocks a `git commit` during a cas run that would include content no passing code + security review has seen.
